title: DriftDetected v1 payload
description: The active week is drifting from its plan at the mid-week check (Thursday evening in the user's time zone). v1 knows one kind: BEHIND_PACE, done work below a share of the planned work.

plannedMinutes.description: Estimates of the week's actions except dropped ones

thresholdMinutes.description: Done minutes below this counted as behind pace (a share of the planned minutes)
